_doc: Emerald overlay of data/hoenn_items.json (version.load_json deep merge), written by converter/gen_items.py with HOENN_VERSION=emerald: pokeemerald's item balls by script label. A ball on the tile of a Sapphire ball (sapphire_twin) takes its slot n (so the Sapphire world's ball there gives Emerald's item); the others have free slots and are placed with the Emerald world (map = the HoennB2 map, built = this build has it). sapphire_only: Sapphire balls Emerald does not have (their slots keep Sapphire's item).
